dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the dorsal-lateral surface exhibit meandering, light-gray perimeters of 2-4 pixel width, creating a sharp gradient transition to the solid low-intensity dark interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters, primarily occurring as discrete points at the eye and whisker bases. Low-intensity blobs are the primary interior content for the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most proximal dorsal macro-annuli form an irregular trapezoid whose longest parallel side is oriented along the longitudinal axis of the subject.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible, thin high-intensity white linear features (vibrissae) projecting from the dark snout area.
